findings.description: Mary Maria Fuller was Daniel Cook's wife. They married about 1820, and she was the mother of his children, including David Cook and Isaac Cook. She was born about 9 May 1798, likely in New Brunswick.
supporting_sources: U.S. and International Marriage Records, 1560-1900 — 1820 marriage of Daniel Cook and Mary Maria Fuller.
Compiled Daniel Cook family record naming Mary Maria Fuller as wife and listing their children together.

findings.description: David Cook, a son of Daniel Cook, appears with the family in the 1850 U.S. federal census household in Great Salt Lake, Utah Territory — the same year and place the family arrived as pioneer emigrants.

details.place: Great Salt Lake, Great Salt Lake, Utah Territory, United States

supporting_sources: 1850 United States Federal Census, Great Salt Lake, Utah Territory — Daniel Cook household.
